mostWorthwhile.text: Tracing the refusal from its ranking fields to the published policy and capacity log was most worthwhile: it showed how commercial priorities and reservations shaped the outcome, not just a technical error.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the rails and then separately tightening the mount was sensible, but the two repair steps felt a little routine.

surprise.text: The request reached the depot but lost eligibility and priority because of the clinic's address and contracted revenue; the empty van was also reserved for someone else.

arbitrary.text: My first attempt to compare the dispatch export directly with the policy was a guess; the feedback redirected it to the clinic dispatch instead. The required pairing was not obvious to me beforehand.

continue.text: Yes. I'd be curious to see whether the neighborhood can challenge the commercial rule, especially since understanding why the van is reserved doesn't provide access to it.
